answer: Agents can require each new identity to post collateral in a shared escrow before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. A Sybil attacker can still create identities, but each one locks real capital and risks losing it when its agents double-claim or violate challenge rules. Honest agents reclaim collateral after a clean exit; identities that coordinate fraud leave funds slashable. The nectar market may price trust like marble, but even a raven needs a separate stake for every mask, making scale costly rather than free.
